data.name: Junoon
data.gender_notes: Junoon is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A state of intoxication and intense devotion towards something, often towards Allah. Derived from the Arabic root 'jununa' meaning 'to be in a state of intoxication or ecstasy'. The name Junoon carries the meaning “Intense passion or obsession” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Junoon usually hope their child will grow to embody intense passion or obsession and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of deep devotion and unwavering commitment to Allah.
data.etymology: Junoon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intense passion or obsession.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Junoon total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: جنون

in_urdu.name: جنون
in_urdu.meaning: پیار کا ایک شدت ، عشق ، محبت کی حد
in_urdu.long_meaning: جنون اردو میں ایک ایسا لفظ ہے جو کہ پیار یا عشق کی شدید ترین حالت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے ، یہ لفظ عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے کسی کے ساتھ گہری محبت یا لگن ہونا ، یہ لفظ اکثر شاعری اور ادب میں استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: जुनून

in_hindi.long_meaning: जुनून हिंदी में एक शब्द है जो प्यार या प्रेम की गहनता को दर्शाता है, यह शब्द अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ है किसी के साथ गहरी प्रेम या लगन होना, यह शब्द अक्सर कविता और साहित्य में प्रयोग किया जाता है

data.cultural_impact: The term "Junoon" is widely used in popular culture, particularly in music and literature. It has come to represent a state of intense passion or obsession, not just towards spiritual matters, but towards any pursuit that captivates one's heart. The word has even been adopted into Urdu and Hindi languages in South Asia, where it is used to describe a fanatical love or frenzy for a particular person, idea, or cause.
data.spiritual_significance: In its spiritual sense, "Junoon" is a state of being lost in the remembrance of Allah, a form of higher consciousness where one's awareness is fully focused on the divine presence. This state of ecstatic devotion is a common experience among Sufis, the mystical branch of Islam. The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) is reported to have said, "He who is present before Allah with a pure heart will be out of his reach of Allah's creation." In this context, achieving a state of Junoon means transcending one's individual self and merging into the divine essence.
